## Accepted partial result; general assertion unresolved

For every h>=0 and every integral input class meeting the original smooth
connected-embedding, positive-area and adjunction-equality hypotheses,
S2 x Sigma_h with its original fixed split symplectic form has a connected
embedded symplectic representative of that class. The full analytic proof
includes sign-controlled degree maps, Moser-adjusted negative section graphs,
connected cyclic multisections, positive-node smoothing and exhaustive
Kneser/genus/area case analysis. Negative-square sections and nonprimitive
square-zero classes are included. This is an explicitly credited ruled
special case in the established literature; no novelty is claimed.

The report also proves a formal differential/same-genus symplectic-immersion
reduction with balanced signed double points, retaining the explicit negative
symplectic-plane intersection that prevents a false embeddedness inference.
For g>0 and b2+>1, all Seiberg–Witten basic classes obey |L(c)|<=K(c), including
negative square via Ozsvath–Szabo Corollary 1.7 with its positive-genus and
simple-type hypotheses. The K-2PD(A) consequence is 0<=A.c<=K(c). The result
makes no genus-zero or chamber-independent b2+=1 extension.

The universal fixed-form four-manifold assertion remains unresolved by this
work. No universal proof or counterexample is presented. The complete
written audit accepts exactly these partial claims. This records substantive
attempt 1 of 5; editorial preparation adds zero proof-attempt responses.

Primary target: K3 Problem 4.100, PDF pages 272–273:
https://math.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/surv-295-ruberman-watermarked-author-pdf.pdf .
The original first-Chern equation fixes K=-c1 and 2g-2=c^2+K(c).
The immersion and negative-square adjunction references are respectively
https://arxiv.org/abs/0812.4929 and https://arxiv.org/abs/math/9811087 .
The package retains the full public scholarly attribution and source limits.

## Distribution and review limits

Exactly eight authored report/audit/acceptance/status and public-source-review
or metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/2976/`.
Every analytic proof, example and qualification is preserved. Editorial edits
remove private paths/revision provenance, clarify recorded verification and
review status, and bind the distributed report and audit exactly. Programs,
datasets, raw generated outputs, copied source bodies, PDFs, images and
private coordination material are excluded. Aggregate checks are only sanity
checks; no omitted file is a mathematical premise.

This AI-assisted, unrefereed edition claims no novelty, bibliographic priority,
external human peer review, journal acceptance, formal proof-assistant
certification or exhaustive certificate of preexisting current openness.
Source inspection and finite-check observations are recorded historical
evidence. Editorial preparation did not rerun mathematical checks, retrieve
or rehash source PDFs, conduct scholarly inspection or run a literature search.

QUEUE.md and all unrelated repository entries remain unchanged. No historical
accounting is reset. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
